description: Financial Intelligence. Brings bank statements, accounts and transactions into one connected view, and shows where the money went, through which accounts, and how fast.

modules.title: 13 capabilities
modules.lede: From raw statements to investigation-ready intelligence, in one workspace.

items.name: Multi-bank statement processing
items.summary: Imports statements from multiple financial institutions in various formats, with automatic standardisation for unified analysis.

items.name: AI-powered transaction analysis
items.summary: Analyses transaction histories, classifies financial activity, detects anomalies and highlights transactions needing investigation.

items.name: Suspicious transaction detection
items.summary: Detects the patterns investigators look for.

details.label: Patterns covered
details.text: Structured or split transactions; circular fund movements; pass-through and funnel accounts; dormant account activation; high-frequency cash withdrawals; immediate fund withdrawals; source concentration; unusual transaction spikes; income-to-asset inconsistencies.

items.name: Risk-based prioritisation
items.summary: Prioritises suspicious transactions against configurable risk indicators.

items.name: Multi-account investigation
items.summary: Analyses many accounts at once to reveal hidden financial relationships between individuals, organisations and entities.

items.name: Relationship & network visualisation
items.summary: Interactive graphs of fund transfers that expose intermediaries, beneficiary accounts and hidden networks.

items.name: Fund trail analysis
items.summary: Traces the complete movement of funds across accounts and reconstructs the money trail.

items.name: Investigation timeline
items.summary: Puts financial events in chronological order to reconstruct what happened when.

items.name: Integrated case management
items.summary: A central workspace for investigations, accounts, evidence and case progress.

items.name: Automated investigation reports
items.summary: Reports with transaction summaries, suspicious findings, relationship analysis, fund trails and supporting evidence.

items.name: Interactive dashboards
items.summary: Dashboards, charts, account summaries and financial insight for investigators and supervisors.

items.name: Enterprise security & access control
items.summary: Role-based access, authentication, audit logs and encrypted data handling.

items.name: Flexible deployment
items.summary: Available as secure cloud; enterprise and on-premises deployment options.

sections.title: The problem
sections.html:
The problem

What it is there to fix.

Statements arrive unreadable

Every bank formats differently, and many arrive as scans, so an investigator retypes thousands of rows before any analysis starts.

The trail crosses accounts

Money moves through mule accounts and shell entities; following it by hand across dozens of statements is impractical within a case timeline.

Findings must stand in court

A spreadsheet of suspicions is not an annexure. The output has to be reproducible and referenced back to the source transaction.

sections.title: How it works
sections.html:
How it works

From input to outcome.

  1. Statements inPDF or spreadsheet statements from multiple institutions.
  2. Extract & normaliseEvery transaction extracted, cleaned and standardised across banks.
  3. AnalyseAI and rule-based analytics classify activity and detect anomalies.
  4. TraceFund trails and relationship graphs across accounts.
  5. ReportInvestigation-ready reports with evidence export.

Who uses it

sections.title: Safeguards
sections.html:
Safeguards

What it will not do, and what it always keeps.

  • All investigation data, documents and reports remain the client's property.
  • Role-based access, encryption and a full audit trail.
  • Court-ready summaries reference the source transaction.
